name: open_new_file_into_record
description: Calls a routine with create-and-write style flags and a fixed permission value, returning null when it yields minus one. On success it moves the handle to the end, stores the handle and a mode byte in the caller's record, and sets a pointer field to the record itself or to an offset inside it, chosen by a global flag.

name: seek_end_and_init_record
description: Moves the handle to the end, sets a mode byte from a flag, and fills the caller's record with the handle, the mode and cleared pointer fields. A global flag decides whether one pointer field points inside the record.

name: fill_record_with_mode_two
description: Sets the mode to two, then fills the caller's record with the handle, the mode and cleared pointer fields. A global flag decides whether one pointer field points inside the record.

name: open_file_with_flag_bit
description: Calls a routine with a flag-selected bit added to a stored value, returning null when it yields minus one. On success it sets the mode to one or 128 by a flag and fills the caller's record with the handle and that mode.

name: obtain_handle_and_fill_record
description: Calls a routine with the record's argument and a stored value, returning null when it yields minus one. On success it sets the mode to one or 128 by a flag and fills the record with the handle, the mode and cleared pointer fields.

name: fill_record_with_mode_flag
description: Sets the mode to one or 128 according to a flag, then fills the caller's record with the handle, that mode and cleared pointer fields. A global flag decides whether one pointer field points inside the record.

name: fill_record_with_mode_one
description: Sets the mode to one, then fills the caller's record with the handle, the mode and cleared pointer fields. A global flag decides whether one pointer field points inside the record.

name: open_flagged_file_into_record
description: Calls a routine with a flag-selected bit, a stored value and a permission value, returning null when it yields minus one. On success it sets the mode to two or 128 by a flag and fills the caller's record with the handle and that mode.

name: open_extended_file_into_record
description: Calls a routine with a flag-selected bit, a stored value and a permission value, returning null when it yields minus one. On success it sets the mode to two or 128 by a flag and fills the caller's record with the handle and that mode.

name: fill_record_with_mode_byte
description: Sets the mode to two or 128 according to a flag, then fills the caller's record with the handle, that mode and cleared pointer fields. A global flag decides whether one pointer field points inside the record.

name: fill_record_with_mode_two
description: Sets the mode to two, then fills the caller's record with the handle, the mode and cleared pointer fields. A global flag decides whether one pointer field points inside the record.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing any other work, so the routine is a minimal stub.

name: store_handle_mode_record
description: Calls a routine with a flag-selected bit, then stores the handle and mode from the locals into the caller's record. It clears the record's pointer fields and the status byte afterwards.

name: reset_record_with_handle_mode
description: Clears a pointer field in the caller's record, then stores the handle and mode from the locals into the record and clears its remaining fields.

name: release_structure_links
description: Calls a routine with the structure when a flag bit is set, and when the flag's other bits are clear and a stored pointer is non-null it calls a routine with the two stored fields. It then clears those fields and the flag byte, and finally calls a routine with the byte stored at offset 17.

name: check_flag_and_return_pointer
description: Calls a routine first when a global flag is non-zero. If the argument is in range and a lookup routine returns an index whose entry has its high bit set, it returns a pointer into the global table at a second index. Otherwise it sets a global status variable to 9 and returns null.

name: allocate_table_slot_with_flags
description: Scans a global table for a free slot and records a limit error with minus one when none is free. It encodes the flags into the slot's status byte, rejects an invalid access mode with an error and minus one, and stores a routine's result in the slot. A zero result records an error, clears the slot and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the slot index.

name: init_table_slot_from_record
description: Takes the slot index from a record and returns minus one with a limit error if it is at the table limit. It encodes the record's flags into the slot's status byte, rejects an invalid access mode, and stores a routine's result in the slot. A zero result records an error and clears the status byte.

name: set_slot_status_from_flags
description: Derives a slot's status byte from a record's flags and access mode, rejects an invalid mode with an error and minus one, then calls a routine whose value is stored in the slot. A zero value records an error, clears the status byte and returns minus one.

name: set_slot_status_with_mode
description: Writes the active status bit into a slot's status byte, adds the mode bits from the record's access flags, and rejects an invalid mode with an error. It stores the result of a routine call in the slot, and a zero result records an error and clears the status byte.

name: set_slot_mode_one_flagged
description: Adds a mode-one bit plus an optional bit chosen by a flag to the slot's status byte. It calls a routine with the first argument when a flag bit is set, then calls a routine with the argument and one of two mode constants and stores the result. A zero result records an error, clears the status byte and returns minus one.

name: set_slot_mode_one_value
description: Adds the mode-one bit to the slot's status byte, then calls a routine with the first argument and one of two mode constants and stores the result in the slot. A zero result records an error, clears the status byte and returns minus one.

name: set_slot_mode_two_flagged
description: Adds a mode-two bit plus an optional bit chosen by a flag to the slot's status byte. It calls a routine with the first argument when a flag bit is set, then calls a routine with the argument and one of two mode constants and stores the result. A zero result records an error, clears the status byte and returns minus one.

name: set_slot_mode_two_value
description: Adds the mode-two bits to the slot's status byte, then calls a routine with the first argument and one of two mode constants and stores the result in the slot. A zero result records an error, clears the status byte and returns minus one.

name: fail_slot_with_invalid_mode
description: Clears the slot's status byte, records an invalid-argument error code and returns minus one.

name: store_slot_file_by_flags
description: Chooses one of two mode constants from a flag group, then calls a routine with the first argument and that constant and stores the result in the slot. A zero result records an error, clears the status byte and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the stored value.

name: open_slot_file_default_mode
description: Uses a fixed mode constant to call a file-open routine with the first argument and stores the handle in the slot. A zero result records an error, clears the status byte and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the stored value.

name: return_stored_value
description: Returns the value held in a local without doing any other work.

name: clear_status_flag_and_forward
description: Forwards its first argument to another routine with a fixed flag set plus the top bit of the second argument, and passes the second argument with that top bit cleared.

name: forward_transfer_to_handle
description: Rejects a negative length with an error code and minus one. Otherwise it looks up a handle record from the first argument and forwards the second argument and length to a routine using the record's stored value. A failed transfer records an error code; a missing record also returns minus one with an error code.

name: read_into_buffer_checked
description: Calls a read library routine on the stored handle with the caller's buffer and length, and keeps the byte count. A result of minus one records an error code, and the count is returned.

name: write_handle_with_error_check
description: Validates a non-negative length and looks up a handle record. When the record's flag bit is set it moves the handle to the end, then writes the buffer through the stored handle. A failed write records an error code and returns minus one; invalid arguments set an error code and return minus one.

name: seek_file_with_offset_table
description: Looks up a handle record and, for an index below three, seeks the file to an offset taken from a global table, recording an error code on failure. It then seeks back to the start and returns that result. An invalid handle or index sets an error code and returns minus one.

name: close_handle_if_flag_clear
description: Looks up a handle record from the argument, returning minus one when it is missing. If a flag bit is set it returns success without closing; otherwise it closes the stored handle, clears the record's status byte and returns success.

name: delete_file_with_error_check
description: Calls a delete-file library routine with the argument. A failure records an error code and returns minus one; success returns zero.

name: forward_single_argument
description: Forwards its single argument to another routine and returns nothing.

name: rename_file_with_error_check
description: Calls a rename library routine with two arguments. A zero result records an error code and returns minus one; otherwise it returns zero.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing any other work, so the routine is a minimal stub.

name: open_global_file_handle
description: Opens the global file record with a fixed mode constant and stores the returned handle in a global variable, then returns.

name: read_next_global_byte
description: Calls routines when a global flag is set and when the stored handle is zero. It returns a pending byte from a global and clears it; otherwise it reads one byte from the stored handle and returns that byte.

name: read_one_byte_from_handle
description: Reads a single byte from the stored handle through a read library routine into a local, and returns that byte.

name: write_single_byte_to_handle
description: Checks two global values and calls a routine when a condition fails, then writes the byte argument to the stored handle with a write library routine. It returns the byte argument.

name: set_global_byte_if_clear
description: Returns minus one without changing anything when a global byte is already non-zero. Otherwise it stores the low byte of the argument in that global and returns the argument.

name: store_low_byte_to_global
description: Copies the low byte of a value taken from the caller's frame into a global byte variable and returns.

name: close_active_handles
description: Walks a table of entries whose count is held in a global. For each non-zero entry without flag bit 4 set it closes the stored handle, then forwards both arguments to another routine.

name: copy_state_and_program_chips
description: Copies a 20-byte global block into the first argument, updates a global byte, and stores one bit chosen by the second argument with the third argument in the copied block. It then writes four custom-chip control registers and returns a value read from a CIA register.

name: return_fixed_value
description: Returns a fixed constant without doing any other work.

name: copy_string_to_destination
description: Copies a null-terminated string from the second argument into the first, byte by byte including the terminator, and returns the destination.

name: copy_bounded_string
description: Copies up to a counted number of bytes from the source to the destination, stopping after a NUL byte. It always writes a NUL terminator after the copied data and returns the destination.

name: reset_global_state_fields
description: Clears a set of global state variables to zero and fills two global buffers through library calls. It stores the first argument and a value derived from a call in globals, and returns no value.

name: toggle_around_paired_calls
description: Calls a routine with 31, flips a global toggle between 0 and 1, calls the same routine with 15, and flips the toggle back.

name: update_timed_counter_state
description: Compares a time reading against a stored base, and when the difference exceeds a threshold or a flag is set it decrements a global counter and calls a routine with the active table entry. Once the counter reaches zero it runs a sequence of routines, swaps the active table index, resets the flag and returns a derived value.

name: format_time_and_output_text
description: Formats a global count as minutes and seconds, or as seconds alone when it is under 60, into a local string using a printf-style routine. It outputs the first five characters one at a time at positions offset from the two arguments, and sets a global flag from whether the first character is a space.

name: call_offset_sequence_at_position
description: Issues a fixed sequence of seven routine calls with the two arguments offset by small constants, one of which passes a block of eleven values.

name: store_slot_and_reset_state
description: Calls routines with two global references, stores the argument into a global slot after reading its previous value, then calls routines with fixed values and a global reference.

name: run_selection_until_confirmed
description: Repeats a selection routine until its result is 1 or 2. Results from 3 to 6 are stored in a global and used to call routines on each table entry. On a result of 1 it maps the stored selection to a global value through a switch with the values 60, 30, 20 and 10, and sets a flag from a bit in a structure.

name: wait_for_selection_and_apply
description: Repeats a selection routine until its result is 1 or 2, storing results from 3 to 6 and calling routines on each table entry. On a result of 1 it maps the stored selection to a global value through a switch with the values 60, 30, 20 and 10, and sets a flag from a bit in a structure.

name: update_flag_and_call_pair
description: Sets a global flag from a bit in a structure, then calls routines with a global reference and a stored value.

name: clear_flag_and_call_pair
description: Clears a global flag, then calls a routine with a global reference and a stored value.

name: assign_offsets_to_linked_records
description: Walks a linked list of records starting at the first argument. For each record with one flag bit set and another clear, it stores a base value in one field, and adds 40 to that value when the record's key equals the second argument.

name: call_library_routine_once
description: Calls a library routine through the global library base with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: show_end_of_game_result
description: Outputs one of several result messages built from score globals, such as a winner, a tie or a no-more-moves ending. It then waits in a loop until a routine returns 1, outputs a closing message and sets a state value to 9 or 7 according to a mode flag.

name: center_entries_in_width
description: Walks four records from a linked list in a global structure. For each record it stores a value from a table in one field, measures the record with a routine, and sets another field to half the difference between a global width and the measured size.

name: draw_indexed_entry_fields
description: Uses the record selected by a global index to output a formatted two-digit value and several fixed fields, at positions taken from that record and the argument. It calls output routines for each element.

name: find_fitting_text_length
description: Measures a null-terminated string and shortens its length one character at a time until a measuring routine reports a width at or below the limit. It returns zero for an empty string, or the length that fits.

name: return_nothing_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing any work, so the routine is a stub.

name: update_small_index_pair
description: For each of two arguments below five, calls a routine twice on the global table with the argument and a flag value, using zero for the first argument and one for the second.

name: initialize_setup_state
description: Clears several global state fields and sets others to fixed values, then calls routines to set up three global entries. It fills a global byte table of 144 entries with a counter that advances at a step decided by a routine result.

name: forward_argument_with_globals
description: Forwards its argument with three global buffer references to a routine, then calls another routine with a fixed value and zero.

name: repeat_call_fifteen_times
description: Calls a routine fifteen times in a loop and returns.

name: return_nothing_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing any work, so the routine is a stub.

name: draw_indexed_element_group
description: Returns the computed counter value when a global flag is set. Otherwise it reads a counter and, when two global flags are set and a second value is non-zero, draws a fixed-position group of elements chosen by a switch on the argument from zero to five before returning the value.

name: clear_saved_selection_state
description: When a mode global is set, it calls routines with the saved entries referenced by two globals and with a fixed value. It then resets seven saved-state globals to zero.

name: draw_indexed_panel_item
description: Positions a numbered item from a table of coordinate values, using a second layout when a global flag is set and the index is from 84 to 87. It calls routines with the computed bounds and the index for both parts of the item.

name: enable_panel_pair
description: Calls a routine for two panel indices with fixed arguments, sets a global flag to one, then calls a routine with a global value.

name: disable_panel_pair
description: Calls a routine for two panel indices with fixed arguments, clears a global flag, then calls a routine with a global value.

name: enable_alternate_panel_pair
description: Calls a routine for two other panel indices with fixed arguments, and sets a global flag to one.

name: disable_alternate_panel_pair
description: Calls a routine for two other panel indices with fixed arguments, and clears a global flag to zero.

name: call_fixed_argument_pair
description: Calls a routine with a fixed value and zero.

name: compare_two_values
description: Calls routines to read two values and returns one when they are equal, after calling a routine with a global and zero. Otherwise it calls a routine with a fixed value and returns zero.

name: call_with_four_return_zero
description: Calls a routine with the value four and returns zero.

name: set_flag_and_run_steps
description: Sets a global flag to one, then calls three routines in sequence, two of them with global buffer references.

name: read_input_and_clear_flag
description: Reads into a 256-byte local buffer through a routine. If that routine returns a non-zero result it calls two routines with global references, and it then clears a global flag.

name: advance_state_and_store_pair
description: When a global mode equals four it increments a per-slot counter and sets two flags. It then outputs a pair of stored values in order, decrements a global counter by two, stores the selected pair in a table at the current index, and resets seven global state fields.

name: clear_flag_and_run_step
description: Clears a global flag to zero, then calls a routine.

name: draw_bounds_for_index_range
description: Calls a routine with four computed bounds, then for indices from 84 to 87 it calls routines with values from a table and computed rectangle positions. It finishes with a routine call and a call with the values one and one.

name: show_status_and_wait
description: Outputs a status message chosen by a state global and a flag, and sets the state to 10, 6 or 5 according to its value. It then waits in a loop until a routine returns a non-zero value and outputs a closing message.

name: output_pair_values_and_advance
description: Looks up the entry at an index and outputs one of its two stored values, chosen by comparing against a key global, then outputs the matching values of the following two entries. It adds two to a counter and calls a routine with fifteen when the counter reaches 144.

name: output_table_values_and_advance
description: Outputs values from table entries at the index, choosing between two stored values by a key comparison, then adds two to a counter and calls a routine with fifteen when the counter reaches 144.

name: output_alternating_table_values
description: Outputs values from table entries at the index in alternating order, then adds two to a counter and calls a routine with fifteen when the counter reaches 144.

name: activate_flag_and_set_limit
description: Sets a global flag to one and a global value to 88, then calls a routine.

name: advance_index_chain_entry
description: Updates a table entry for the given index by following the value stored there, marks the entry it reaches as one, increments the index's counter, and calls a routine with the index.

name: advance_index_chain_from_frame
description: Sets a table entry from the value it points to, marks the entry it reaches as one, increments the counter for the index taken from the caller's frame, and calls a routine with that index.

name: check_index_available
description: Returns zero when the table entry for the index is empty, or when the index is in the range 84 to 87 while a flag is set. Index two depends on global values, and a chained entry that is set returns zero. Lower indices return one.

name: check_index_available_frame
description: Returns zero for a chained table entry that is set or for an index in the range 84 to 87 while a flag is set, using an index taken from the caller's frame. Index two depends on global values, and lower indices return one.

name: check_index_chain_available
description: Returns one or zero from the availability conditions without the empty-entry or range checks. Index two depends on global values, chained entries decide the rest, and lower indices return one.

name: check_chained_entry_free
description: Returns zero when a chained table entry is set for the index, and returns one for indices below 89 otherwise.

name: check_chain_for_high_index
description: Returns one for indices below 89. For higher indices it returns zero when a chained table entry is set, and one otherwise.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one without doing any other work, so the routine is a stub.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one without doing any other work, so the routine is a stub.

name: draw_remaining_tiles_panel
description: Draws a panel from fixed rectangle values, then outputs a text line containing a remaining-count value formatted as three digits, taken from a global. It finishes with another fixed text line.

name: dispatch_layout_by_index
description: Returns minus one for a non-positive argument. Otherwise it selects a fixed group of routine calls by the index, with several cases sharing code, and each call passes a fixed list of small values. It returns the result of the last call.

name: emit_flagged_argument_list
description: Optionally calls a routine with an identifier computed from the second argument. Then, for up to four of the remaining arguments that are one or zero, it calls the same routine with an identifier built from the index and the first argument.

name: test_state_one_to_four
description: Returns one when the state global is between one and four inclusive, and zero otherwise.

name: switch_state_between_pairs
description: Changes the state global from six to two or from five to one, and calls routines for each change. The follow-up call sequence depends on a second global.

name: call_fixed_default_layout
description: Calls a routine with a fixed list of eleven values and returns.

name: set_state_two_and_layout
description: Sets the state global to two, calls a routine with two fixed values, then calls a routine with one of two fixed value lists chosen by a flag.

name: call_fixed_default_layout
description: Calls a routine with a fixed list of eleven values and returns.

name: pop_list_head_and_call
description: Calls a routine with the argument, then clears a link entry, moves the head to the next linked value, decrements the head's counter, and calls a routine with the argument and the new value.

name: draw_grid_cell_and_neighbours
description: Computes the screen position of a cell from its index in a 15-column grid, choosing offsets for edge and centre cells. It draws the cell's background, then draws the outlines and labels of each neighbouring cell that holds a value.

name: run_input_until_result
description: Stores an argument and a routine's value in a record, then repeatedly calls a routine until it returns one or two. It returns the final result.

name: collect_text_entries_until_result
description: Reads text into a 256-byte buffer, splits it into up to four entries separated by NUL bytes, and stores each entry's pointer and measured width in records. It then loops until a routine returns one or two and returns that result.

name: wait_for_choice_result
description: Calls a routine, then keeps calling a routine until its result is one or two, and returns that result.

name: wait_until_result_is_one
description: Initializes a record with an argument and a fixed byte value, calls a routine for a value, then calls a routine repeatedly until it returns one and returns that value.

name: drain_entry_list_to_count
description: Repeatedly takes an entry from a list. Entries of one type go to a routine, and other entries are copied into a 20-byte buffer through a routine that uses 52 as its size, until a counter reaches 64. It returns a field from the last entry.

name: forward_with_global_table_pair
description: Forwards its argument to a routine together with two global table references and a global reference.

name: build_display_item_records
description: Walks a linked list of entries for one slot and fills consecutive 44-byte display records from them. A switch on each entry's type sets positions, sizes and pointers, and text entries are measured by a routine to centre them in the slot width. The first record is linked into the list head.

name: fill_display_record_from_item
description: Writes a 23-byte record from an item's position and size fields, sets its type byte to 23, and clears its other fields.

name: search_slot_table_for_entry
description: Searches up to five global table entries for one whose key matches the record's entry, and calls a routine with the matched value. It then calls routines with the record's value and returns the result of the final routine.

name: set_layout_limit_by_state
description: Sets two global limit values to 63 when the state global is three, and to 47 otherwise. It sets a related global from the second argument and calls a routine with the argument and a global reference.

name: compare_strings_counted
description: Compares up to a counted number of bytes of two strings. It returns the first byte difference, one or minus one when one string ends first, and zero when the compared part matches.

name: scan_unquoted_characters
description: Scans a string, skipping quoted sections and backslash escapes, and passes each unquoted character to a routine until that routine returns non-zero. It returns the number of bytes scanned.

name: return_nothing_stub
description: Returns immediately with no work, so the routine is a stub.

name: compare_strings_full
description: Compares two null-terminated strings and returns the byte difference at the first mismatch, or zero when they are equal.

name: call_library_offset_thirty
description: Calls a library function through the library base held in the argument, at a fixed negative offset of thirty, and returns nothing.

name: initialize_slot_tables
description: Clears seven state globals and sets a count global to 144. It calls a routine with a fixed value, then fills a global table: indices 1 to 144 are set to one, 0 to 88 to their own index, 1 to 51 to one, 52 to 71 to two, 72 to 83 to three, and 84 to 87 to four.

name: return_absolute_value
description: Returns the absolute value of a 16-bit argument.

name: return_sum_of_two_calls
description: Calls two routines that each return a value and returns their sum.

name: shuffle_index_table
description: Fills a 144-entry array with the indices one to 144, then shuffles it by swapping each entry with an earlier entry chosen by a routine. It records each index's new position in a second table.

name: reset_count_and_call_pair
description: Sets a count global to 144, calls a routine, then calls a routine with two global references.

name: output_table_value_and_char
description: Calls a routine twice with the table value at the first index, then calls a routine with the byte at the second index as a signed value.

name: call_fixed_sequence_for_pair
description: Issues a fixed sequence of five routine calls, using fixed indices and the global pair positions offset by fixed amounts.

name: draw_grid_and_report_state
description: Clears a global counter and calls a routine. When a state value is non-zero it draws each entry of a 15 by 8 table, then draws pending overlays, and it returns a value from a routine chosen by the state.

name: draw_positive_entry_frame
description: Calls a routine with the entry value at the index. When that entry's count is positive it outputs the entry's position, a fixed frame call and the associated values.

name: find_cell_under_position
description: Converts a position to a grid column clamped to 0 to 12 and a row clamped to 0 to 6. It then checks up to nine neighbouring cells with a routine, stops at the first one that matches, and stores that cell as the selection.

name: update_selection_from_table
description: When a flag is set it draws a fixed item and checks it with a routine, recording the selection if the check succeeds. It then stores the current selection and copies the matching table value into a second global.

name: copy_selected_entry_value
description: Copies a value from a global table at the current selection index into a second global.

name: handle_two_step_selection
description: Returns when the selected cell is empty or does not fit the pending picks. Otherwise it advances a two-pick selection: a first pick stores the cell, and a second pick either matches and clears the pick or stores a second cell. A routine check that fails reverts the second pick.

name: advance_two_pick_selection
description: Advances a two-pick selection for the selected cell. A first pick stores the cell, and a second pick either matches and clears the pick or stores a second cell that is reverted when a routine check fails.

name: select_cell_if_available
description: Returns when a routine reports the selected cell is unavailable. Otherwise it runs the two-pick selection for that cell, storing or clearing the first and second picks.

name: run_two_pick_state_machine
description: Runs the two-pick state machine on the selected cell: state zero starts a pick, state one either finishes a matching pair or records a second cell, and state two resolves the pending pair.

name: update_two_pick_state
description: Resolves a pending pair in the two-pick state: a match moves the first pick forward, a repeat of the second cell clears it, and the state and output routines are then called.

name: record_second_pick_candidate
description: Increments the pick state, stores the selected cell as the second pick, and calls a routine. If the pair check fails it undoes the increment and clears the second pick.

name: flag_invalid_selection_pick
description: Calls a routine with the pick state and a fixed value, then sets a global flag to one.

name: clear_second_pick_state
description: When the pick state is two, it resets the pending pick, or clears the second pick when the selected cell matches the first pick, then calls output routines.

name: revert_unmatched_second_pick
description: When the selected cell equals the second pick, it decrements the pick state and clears the second pick, then calls output routines.

name: toggle_pick_at_cell
description: Checks the selected cell's table value and returns when it is in the excluded range. Otherwise it toggles the pick state between zero and one, calling output routines for each change.

name: toggle_pick_at_current_cell
description: Toggles the pick state of the currently selected cell between zero and one, calling output routines for each change.

name: start_or_end_pick
description: Starts a pick when the state is zero, or ends it when the state is one and the selected cell matches the stored pick. Otherwise it returns with no change.

name: toggle_pick_state_plain
description: Starts a pick when the state is zero, or ends it when the state is one, calling output routines for each change.

name: cancel_pending_pick
description: When the pick state is one, it resets the pick state and two pick globals to zero, calls output routines, and calls a routine with a global reference and a fixed value.

name: finish_selection_and_reset
description: Finishes a selection: for a matching stored value it calls one routine, otherwise it outputs the selected cell and, for cells from 84 to 87 when a flag is set, calls another routine. It decrements a counter, outputs status, and resets the pick state and four pick globals.

name: finish_pick_and_reset_state
description: Decrements a counter, outputs the status for the selected cell, and resets the pick state and four pick globals. When the counter reaches zero it calls a routine with a global reference instead.

name: reset_pick_state_and_output
description: Calls two routines with fixed values, then clears the pick state and four pick globals.

name: check_cell_placement_allowed
description: Returns zero after a routine reports a message code when the cell's chained entries or a range restriction forbid placement. Index two uses a different pair of global flags. Otherwise it returns one.

name: check_cell_placement_from_frame
description: Returns zero after a routine reports a message code when a chained entry for the frame's index is set or the index is in the range 84 to 87 while a flag is set. Otherwise it returns one.

name: check_restricted_range_flag
description: Returns zero after a routine reports a message code when the frame's index is in the range 84 to 87 while a flag is set. Otherwise it returns one.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one without doing any other work, so the routine is a stub.

name: run_selection_loop_until_final
description: Calls a selection routine with a fixed value in a loop, calling output routines for each state until the result is final. It returns the chosen value, zero when the result is two, or a value from a follow-up routine.

name: run_selection_loop_from_frame
description: Runs a selection loop like its neighbours, taking its state from the caller's frame. It calls output routines for each state until the result is final, and returns the chosen value or zero.

name: run_selection_loop_retry_state
description: Runs a selection loop that calls output routines for each state and repeats until the result is final. It returns the chosen value, zero when the result is two, or a value from a follow-up routine.

name: run_selection_loop_resume
description: Resumes a selection loop at its entry point, calling output routines for each state until the selection is final. It returns the chosen value or zero.

name: run_selection_loop_restart
description: Restarts a selection loop, calling output routines for each state until the selection is final. It returns the chosen value, zero when the result is two, or a value from a follow-up routine.

name: finish_selection_with_fallback
description: Finishes a selection and returns one when the selection stands. Otherwise it resets the pick state and outputs status through routines, returning the result of a final routine.

name: finish_selection_if_unchanged
description: Finishes a selection when its result is unchanged, resetting the pick state and outputting status through routines.

name: restore_selection_and_refresh
description: Restores the pick state from the frame, then calls output routines for the current selection.

name: load_tour_file_state
description: Loads a tour file's state by calling routines with a file name and a fixed value, stores the result, and calls output routines depending on whether a result was found.

name: draw_panel_wait_for_choice
description: Draws a panel from fixed entries and a record, then waits in a loop until a routine returns one or two. When the result is one it runs a loop over 145 global entries and calls output routines to finish.

name: confirm_replace_and_set_limit
description: Checks whether a stored entry exists and, if so, asks a routine with a reference text whether to replace it. It then runs a selection loop, and on a result of one it sets a limit value from a switch on values four to seven (0, 1200, 600 or 300).

name: run_selection_loop_set_limit
description: Runs a selection loop that calls routines for each table entry until the result is one or two. On a result of one it sets a limit value from a switch on values four to seven (0, 1200, 600 or 300), then calls output routines. It returns one when the selection was not confirmed, otherwise zero.

name: run_selection_loop_frame_limit
description: Runs a selection loop that takes its state from the caller's frame and calls routines for each table entry until the result is one or two. On a result of one it sets a limit value from a switch on values four to seven, then calls output routines. It returns one when the selection was not confirmed.

name: finish_selection_and_report
description: Calls output routines for two values, then runs a routine and returns one when its result is non-zero, after calling output routines to finish. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero without doing any other work, so the routine is a stub.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one without doing any other work, so the routine is a stub.

name: draw_time_left_label
description: Outputs a label at a position offset by six and twelve from two global coordinates, then calls output routines at the same coordinates twice.

name: return_nothing_stub
description: Returns immediately without doing any work, so the routine is a stub.

name: build_score_entry_records
description: When a count global is non-zero, builds that many text records from table values, storing each text pointer, a position and a computed centre offset. Otherwise it stores a fallback text pointer.

name: clear_score_entry_count
description: Calls a routine with two global references, then clears the score entry count.

name: reset_score_display_state
description: Calls routines to reset the display and output fixed values, stores the current count in a second global, sets a flag to one, and stores the result of a routine in another global.

name: tick_countdown_timer
description: When the elapsed time since the last tick exceeds 256, decrements a remaining-time counter. At each full minute it outputs a warning when a flag is set, redraws a fixed item, and advances the tick base by 256. When the counter reaches zero it calls a routine to end the countdown.

name: show_tournament_result_text
description: Builds a results message from the placement, the tie wording and the scores, outputs it, and waits in a loop until a routine returns one. It then outputs closing text and sets the state to eight.

name: insert_score_into_table
description: Inserts a score into a table of up to five sorted entries and returns six when the table is full and the score is below the last entry. Otherwise it finds the rank position, shifts lower entries down by copying 54-byte blocks, stores the score, increments the entry count up to five, and returns the rank.

name: shift_global_variable_left
description: Returns a global variable multiplied by eight.

name: forward_value_twice
description: Forwards its argument to a routine twice, passing it as both arguments, and returns.

name: allocate_block_from_free_list
description: Returns null for a non-positive size. Otherwise it walks a free list of blocks in a global pool, takes the first block that is large enough, and splits off the remainder or unlinks the block when it fits exactly. It decrements a global free-size counter, and when no block fits it calls routines to add a block and retries.

name: forward_with_repeated_second
description: Forwards its first argument to a routine with the second argument repeated as the last two arguments, and returns.

name: insert_or_merge_block_node
description: Inserts a block of a given size at a position into a sorted list, returning minus one when the size is non-positive or the block would overlap. It links a new node, extends an adjacent node, or merges with the following node, and adjusts a global counter.

name: format_scaled_decimal_digits
description: Scales a 64-bit value by shifts and writes its decimal digits into a 20-byte buffer with zero padding. It copies the digits to the destination, stores the digit count and a flag, and returns them.

name: format_scaled_digits_alt
description: Writes the decimal digits of a scaled 64-bit value into a 20-byte buffer through the same shifting loop, then copies them to the destination and stores the digit count and flag.

name: format_scaled_digits_loop
description: Repeatedly shifts a 64-bit value and writes zero-padded decimal digits into a buffer, then copies the digits to the destination and stores the digit count. It returns with the destination advanced.

name: format_scaled_digits_resume
description: Resumes the scaled-digit loop, shifting a 64-bit value and writing zero-padded digits before copying them to the destination and storing the digit count.

name: pad_and_copy_digit_buffer
description: Writes zero digits into the buffer from a position up to 19, then copies the digits to a destination buffer, handling a leading flag. It stores the digit count and flag, then returns them.

name: write_digit_characters_and_copy
description: Writes each digit as a character from a carry value, then copies the digits to the destination buffer and stores the digit count and flag.

name: decrement_loop_until_zero
description: Decrements a short value in a loop until it reaches zero, then returns with no other effect.

name: scale_pair_by_ten
description: Returns a 64-bit value whose low part is the second argument multiplied by ten, and whose high part is the first argument combined with shifts, carries and a multiplication by five, adjusted by sign tests.

name: shift_bits_into_decimal_digits
description: Shifts a 64-bit value left one bit per iteration over 64 iterations, feeding each bit into a running digit accumulator. Whenever the accumulator exceeds nine it subtracts ten and adds one to the high part, so the decimal digits are built as the value shifts.

name: check_signal_and_dispatch
description: Calls a system routine with a fixed mask and returns zero when the masked result is clear. Otherwise, when a global flag is set, it outputs fixed values chosen by a bit, then calls a routine for each index up to a global count before returning the result of a final call.

name: call_fixed_setup_pair
description: Calls a routine with two global references and the value twelve, then calls it with a global reference and the value 2560.

name: draw_indexed_segment_outline
description: Clears a pending state when one is set, resets the fields of a record, and draws a set of outlined segments around the first two arguments. The placement depends on values from a global table for the index and on state flags, using several routine calls for each layout branch.

name: clamp_coordinates_then_call
description: Clamps the first and second arguments to be non-negative and within the width and height stored in a structure, then calls a routine with the clamped values.
